course: Introduction to Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things
assignment_title: Introduction to Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things Week 8 Assignment

questions.question: Which type of IIoT analytics is responsible for informing about the remaining useful life of an asset and typically operates on a timescale of hours?
Which of the following software tools is highlighted for its use in Complex Event Processing (CEP) during real-time stream analytics?
In the context of unsupervised learning, what is a primary distinction of the Fuzzy c-Means (FCM) algorithm compared to K-Means?

options.a: FCM allows a data point to belong to more than one cluster
options.b: FCM is significantly slower than K-Means
options.c: FCM requires a labeled dataset to operate
options.d: FCM is categorized as Hard Clustering

questions.correct_answer: FCM allows a data point to belong to more than one cluster

questions.question: Which supervised learning algorithm is specifically utilized when the output variable to be predicted is a real number (e.g., dollars or weight)?
What is a key difference between Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Supervised Learning?

options.a: RL is guided by an external supervisor who knows the environment
options.b: RL utilizes a reward function that acts as feedback to the agent
options.c: RL maps inputs directly to outputs without an agent
options.d: Supervised learning models build knowledge graphs from actions

questions.correct_answer: RL utilizes a reward function that acts as feedback to the agent

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes why Deep Learning differs from traditional Machine Learning in industrial applications?

options.a: Deep learning performs significantly worse as the data volume increases
options.b: Deep learning is an 'end-to-end learning' process that extracts features on its own
options.c: Deep learning requires features to be explicitly mentioned by domain experts
options.d: Deep learning requires very low computational power

questions.correct_answer: Deep learning is an 'end-to-end learning' process that extracts features on its own

questions.question: Which company utilizes Collaborative Distributed Deep Learning technology where the learning process is performed in the cloud while inference is conducted at the edge?
Which of the following is an example of an industrial Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application?
A cloud setup that is designed by combining two or more unique cloud infrastructures (public or private) to provide flexibility for data and application movement is called a:
Which industrial cloud platform utilizes 'Digital Twin Technology' for learning, estimating, optimizing, and representing assets?
The C3 IoT platform provides a storage service for unstructured data known as the C3 Data Lake. In which format is this data primarily managed?
Which of the following industrial IoT platforms specifically provides solutions like 'Now' and 'Tracker' for real-time asset tracking with geo-localized data?
Which of the following is a crucial feature that an IIoT cloud platform provider should offer for effective device management?
According to Sturm et al., which of the following is one of the defined characteristics of a 'Meaningful SLA' (Service Level Agreement)?
How does Fog Computing primarily address the limitations of a purely centralized cloud-based approach in IIoT?

options.a: By identifying useful data and reducing the amount of raw data sent to the cloud
options.b: By completely replacing the cloud infrastructure
options.c: By increasing the latency of time-sensitive data
options.d: By restricting the mobility of edge devices

questions.correct_answer: By identifying useful data and reducing the amount of raw data sent to the cloud
